title_en: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender: The Art of the Movie Preview Reveals Stunning Concept Art and Never-Before-Seen Designs From the New Film
summary_en: Check out an exclusive new look at the stunning art book Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender - The Art of the Movie.
body_en:
Avatar: The Last Airbender fans have certainly been eating well in 2026. The live-action series recently returned for a second season on Netflix , and the spinoff series Avatar: Seven Havens debuted to plenty of acclaim . But for many fans, the real highlight of 2026 has been Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender, a new movie set after the events of the original animated series. Now those fans can celebrate their love of the film with a new art book from Abrams Books.
Ahead of its November 10 release, IGN can exclusively debut a new preview of Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender - The Art of the Movie. Check it out in the slideshow gallery below:
Here's the official description of the book:
Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender - The Art of the Movie will be released on November 10. You can preorder a copy on Amazon .
In IGN's review of Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender , Alex Zalben writes, "Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender is a lovingly crafted and gorgeously animated movie that features a welcome return for Team Avatar. While the plot might be a little thin, the action scenes and settings are thrilling and deserved to be seen on the big screen instead of streaming after a scuttled theatrical release and unfortunate leak changed plans that would have made this more of an event for fans."
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
